description: er-grouping.v1 groups the pairwise decisions of one published decision run into canonical researcher and work assignments. It adds no score, weight, feature or threshold, never changes a decision, never edits a source record and makes no model call. Grouping quality is unevaluated: no evaluation covers canonical groups.

mergeOrder.definition: researchers and works are grouped separately; every member starts as a group of one; only ACCEPTED decisions are links; links are merged one at a time in this order (path rank, then confidence descending, then sourceId and targetId by UTF-8 bytes; a pair appears at most once per kind, so the order is total); a link whose ends are already in one group is kept as a redundant supporting link; otherwise every veto rule is evaluated on the two groups and every rule that fires is recorded; the link is merged only when none fires

vetoRules.definition: a REJECTED or CONFLICT decision exists between a member of one group and a member of the other; UNRESOLVED never vetoes
a REJECTED or CONFLICT decision exists between a member of one group and a member of the other; UNRESOLVED never vetoes
some cross pair (x in one group, y in the other) both assert the scheme and their canonical value sets are disjoint; the reason code is suffixed with the scheme
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 step 2 (T1 disagreement, nothing overrides it)

vetoRules.definition: some cross pair both assert the scheme and their comparable value sets are disjoint (arxiv compared by base submission ID); the reason code is suffixed with the scheme
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 step 2 (T1 disagreement, nothing overrides it)

vetoRules.definition: some cross pair disagrees on the scheme and that pair has no accepting T1 agreement of its own (it shares no orcid and no dblp-pid value); the reason code is suffixed with the scheme
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 steps 3, 4, 6a, 7 and 8 per pair: only a T1 agreement of the pair overrides a blocking disagreement

vetoRules.definition: some cross pair disagrees on the scheme and that pair has no accepting T1 agreement of its own: it shares a doi of which at least one shared value has no preprint prefix, or it shares a doi or an arxiv base submission ID while both sides are pure preprints (publication stage evidence); the reason code is suffixed with the scheme
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 step 6a override per pair (the exact accepting T1 agreement of the pairwise policy)

vetoRules.definition: a mention in one group and a mention in the other are on the same work ID
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 context.same_work (step 5 and step 7 same-work rule)

vetoRules.definition: a DBLP-sourced member in one group and a DBLP-sourced member in the other have equal base names (folded given parts and family words of the parsed name, homonym number removed) and two different DBLP homonym numbers; a number against no number never fires
vetoRules.mirrors: er-policy.v8 name.homonym_suffix_both and name.homonym_suffix_agree (steps 5 and 7), narrowed to the same base name and DBLP-sourced names

vetoRules.definition: a member of one group is a pure preprint and a member of the other is a pure published record (publication stage evidence of its own identifiers); a backstop that er-policy.v8 decisions cannot trigger

endpointCheckDefinition: for every ACCEPTED decision no veto rule may fire on its two endpoints alone; otherwise the curated inputs differ from the ones decided and the run is refused
anchorDefinition: an identifier value is collided when members of more than one final group assert it (unresolved members included); in anchor order a group takes the first scheme of which it holds exactly one distinct value that is not collided; otherwise its member ID that is smallest by UTF-8 bytes (namespace member); an orcid anchor gives the ORCID-form researcher ID, every other anchor the versioned ScholarChain form; reason codes grouping.anchor.<namespace> and grouping.anchor-collision.<scheme>
statusRules: resolved: the member's final group has two or more members
singleton: a group of one with no pending, vetoed or conflict decision (REJECTED only is fine), any anchor
singleton t1-anchored: a group of one with a pending, vetoed or conflict decision whose anchor is its own non-collided orcid or dblp-pid
unresolved: every other group of one; no researcher ID
representativeDefinition: the representative of a work group is its member of the first namespace in representative order, the smallest work ID by UTF-8 bytes among several; the canonical work ID is the representative's own work ID; an unknown namespace refuses the run
graphEligibility: a work group with a DBLP member is counted: its DBLP representative is counted and every other member is member-of-counted; every member of any other group is enrichment-only; teams exist only for counted works that have mentions; authorship records exist for every identified mention on every representative
